source: Original (2026-11-18, AA HL 5.18, no calculator). Forming DEs from words; targets the 5-4CW 1(d) sign error.

parts.label: a
parts.description: Bacteria P increase at a rate proportional to P. Write a DE (k > 0).

parts.label: b
parts.description: Drug amount A decreases at a rate proportional to A. Write a DE (k > 0).
parts.notes: A1 for dA/dt = -kA. dA/dt = kA earns A0 (k is positive and A decreases).

parts.label: c
parts.description: Tank volume V decreases at a rate proportional to root V. Write a DE (k > 0).
parts.notes: A1 for dV/dt = -k sqrt(V). Missing negative: A0.

parts.label: d
parts.description: Rumour in a school of 400: rate proportional to (number who have heard) x (number who have not). Write a DE.
parts.notes: A1 for a rate proportional to a product including N. A1 for the factor 400 - N. kN(N - 400): A1A0.

parts.label: e
parts.description: Explain from the DE why the rumour spreads slowly at first and slowly near the end.

expected.answer: N small makes the product small (few spreaders); N near 400 makes 400 - N small (few left to hear).

parts.notes: R1 for N small => factor N small => rate small. R1 for N near 400 => factor 400 - N small => rate small. Each R1 must refer to the factor or product, not context alone.

source: Original. dN/dt = kN(400 - N), N(0) = 40. Structure after AA HL 2021 May P2 TZ1 Q12; targets the 5-4CW 2(b) error (log of a sum / term-by-term exponentiation).

parts.label: a
parts.description: Find A and B with 1/(N(400 - N)) = A/N + B/(400 - N).
parts.notes: M1 for 1 = A(400 - N) + BN or equating coefficients. A1 for both values.

parts.label: b
parts.description: By solving the DE, show ln(N/(400 - N)) = 400kt - ln 9.
parts.notes: M1 for separating with integral signs. A1 for ln N. A1 for -ln(400 - N) (chain-rule negative). M1 for using t = 0, N = 40. A1 for the constant -ln 9 (or ln(1/9)) leading to the AG. Wrong method: +ln(400 - N) gives ln(N(400 - N)): A0 for that term and A0 for the constant.

parts.label: c
parts.notes: M1 for exponentiating both sides correctly (e^(a - ln 9) = e^a / 9). Term-by-term exponentiation, N/(400 - N) = e^(400kt) - 9: M0. M1 for collecting the N terms. A1 for the division by e^(400kt) seen, reaching the AG.

source: Original. N = 400/(1 + 9e^(-400kt)); N(2) = 100. Numbers chosen so linear extrapolation gives wrong answers in (b) and (d).

parts.label: a
parts.description: After 2 days N = 100. Show k = ln 3 / 800.
parts.notes: M1 for substituting t = 2, N = 100 and rearranging to 9e^(-800k) = 3. A1 for e^(-800k) = 1/3 (or e^(800k) = 3) and 800k = ln 3 seen before the AG.

parts.label: b
parts.notes: M1 for 200 = 400/(1 + 9e^(-400kt)) leading to 9e^(-400kt) = 1. A1 for 400kt = ln 9 with 400k = (ln 3)/2. A1 for t = 4. Wrong method: straight line through (0, 40) and (2, 100) gives 16/3: M0A0A0.

parts.label: c
parts.notes: M1 for e^(-(t/2) ln 3) = 3^(-t/2). A1 for 9 = 3^2 combined with 3^(-t/2) to give 3^(2 - t/2).

parts.label: d
parts.notes: M1 for 400/(1 + 3^(-2)). A1 for 360. Wrong method: straight-line continuation of 40, 100, 200 gives 400: M0A0.
parts.follow_through: FT from (c) or from their k.

parts.label: e
parts.description: Write down the limit of N as t tends to infinity and interpret it.

expected.answer: 400; eventually every student hears the rumour

parts.notes: A1 for 400. R1 for the interpretation in context (all students in the school), not just 'levels off'.

source: Original. General logistic dP/dt = kP(N - P). Structure after AA HL 2022 May P2 TZ2 Q12(b)-(d); targets the 5-4CW 4(c) error (a reason is required).

parts.label: a

expected.answer: d2P/dt2 = k(N - 2P) dP/dt = k^2 P(N - P)(N - 2P)

parts.notes: M1 for differentiating with respect to t with the chain rule. A1 for k(N - 2P) dP/dt. A1 for substituting dP/dt = kP(N - P) to reach the AG. Missing the factor dP/dt: M0.

parts.label: b
parts.description: Hence show the population increases at its greatest rate when P = N/2; justify.

expected.answer: P = N/2; d2P/dt2 changes from positive to negative there

parts.tolerance: Accept the quadratic-vertex argument for dP/dt as a function of P.
parts.notes: M1 for setting d2P/dt2 = 0. A1 for P = N/2 (rejecting P = 0, P = N). R1 for a reason: sign change of d2P/dt2 from + to -, or dP/dt = k(NP - P^2) is a downward quadratic in P with vertex at N/2. 'd2P/dt2 = 0' alone earns R0.

parts.label: c
parts.description: Find the greatest value of dP/dt in terms of k and N.
parts.notes: M1 for substituting P = N/2 into dP/dt. A1 for kN^2/4.

parts.label: d
parts.description: For the rumour, find the greatest spreading rate and when it occurs.
parts.tolerance: Accept 200 ln 3 / 4 or any exact equivalent; accept about 55 if exact form also seen.
parts.notes: A1 for 50 ln 3. A1 for t = 4 (or when N = 200).
